verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows WorkOS provides identity/auth features (SSO, Directory Sync, Vault encryption, Audit Logs, migration tools) but nothing documents explicit data retention policies or a deletion/right-to-erasure mechanism for user or customer data. Community commentary even raises unresolved concerns about how to export/delete data when leaving WorkOS (workos-comm-8), reinforcing the absence of documented retention/deletion controls.
